blocks.html: 2016 is foreseen to be a great time for adventure so ring in an auspicious year and join Robinsons Malls as it welcomes the Year of the Red Fire Monkey with good vibes and good fortune.

From February 1 to 8, shop at any Robinsons Malls establishment and find your luck at the Money Trees to win exciting discounts, freebies and giveaways. A feast for your senses await as an 8 ft. tall and 6 ft. in diameter Money Tree and 12 life-size Zodiac Animals highlight Chinese New Year festivities in Robinsons Galleria.
Witness the much-anticipated traditional Lion and Dragon Dance on February 6 in Robinsons Luisita and Robinsons Pangasinan, on February 7 in Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Ilocos, Robinsons Dasmariñas, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Cainta and Summit Ridge Tagaytay and on February 8 in Robinsons Place Manila, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Place Malolos and Robinsons Otis.

Know what’s in store for you as experts share their tips in the feng shui consultation on February 7 to 8 in Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas and Robinsons Place Imus.

Delve into the Chinese arts of Lantern Making on February 7 to 8 in Robinsons Place Lipa and Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Chinese calligraphy on February 6 to 7 in Robinsons Galleria and Robinsons Place Imus and Chinese Opera from February 6 to 8 in Summit Ridge Tagaytay, Robinsons Place Imus and Robinsons Place Dasmariñas.
For more updates on Robinsons Malls events and schedules, visit www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls.
